# World Curling Live Scores

> > Official live scoring and team information platform for World Curling Federation events, including Olympic Games, World Championships, and continental competitions.

This platform provides real-time scoring, team rosters, standings, and tournament information for all levels of competitive curling worldwide. Powered by CURLIT scoring system, it covers men's, women's, mixed, junior, and senior divisions across international championships.

## Key Topics

- World Curling
- CURLIT
- Olympic Winter Games 2026
- World Junior Curling Championships
- World Senior Curling Championships
- European Curling Championships
- Olympic Qualification Event
- Team rosters
- Final standings
- Canada
- Denmark
- Men's teams
- Cortina d'Ampezzo
- Copenhagen
- Östersund

## Olympic Curling

- [Curling @ Olympic Winter Games 2026 - Final Standings: Men](https://livescores.worldcurling.org/og/aspnet/standingsall): Men's final standings for Olympic curling 2026 in Cortina d'Ampezzo
- [Olympic Qualification Event 2025 - Teams: Men](https://livescores.worldcurling.org/oqe/aspnet/teams): Men's team rosters for Olympic Qualification 2025 in Kelowna, BC

## World Championships

- [World Junior Curling Championships 2026 - Teams: Men](https://livescores.worldcurling.org/wjcc/aspnet/teams): Men's team rosters for World Junior Championships 2026 in Copenhagen
- [World Senior Curling Championships 2026 - Teams: Men](https://livescores.worldcurling.org/wscc/aspnet/teams): Men's team rosters for World Senior Championships 2026 in Geneva

## Continental Championships

- [European Curling Championships C-Division 2025 - Teams: Men](https://livescores.worldcurling.org/eccc/aspnet/teams): Men's team rosters for European C-Division 2025 in Östersund, Sweden
